definitions.explanation: A break or pause in the middle of an activity, event, or period. Can refer to a literal rest period or a temporary lull in something ongoing.

examples.japanese: {午前中|ごぜんちゅう}の{中休|なかやす}みにコーヒーを{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: I had coffee during the mid-morning break.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{中休|なかやす}みで{久|ひさ}しぶりに{晴|は}れた。
examples.english: There was a break in the rainy season and it was sunny for the first time in a while.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{会議|かいぎ}の{途中|とちゅう}で{十分間|じゅっぷんかん}の{中休|なかやす}みを{取|と}った。
examples.english: We took a ten-minute break in the middle of the long meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used for weather patterns — {梅雨|つゆ}の{中休|なかやす}み (a break in the rainy season) and {猛暑|もうしょ}の{中休|なかやす}み (a break from the intense heat) are very common expressions in weather forecasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {梅雨|つゆ}の{中休|なかやす}み (break in the rainy season)
- {中休|なかやす}みを{取|と}る (to take a mid-break)
- {猛暑|もうしょ}の{中休|なかやす}み (respite from extreme heat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {休憩|きゅうけい}: break, rest (more general and formal)
- {一息|ひといき}: a breather (shorter, more casual)
